game_title: Flowchart Lab · Sum from 1 to n
game_concept: A arcade set in Mt. Pyre – Lava Tube Tunnel, a glowing lava tube: the volcanologist must handle lava imps while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Divide Or Floor: Pick / or // to split cooling flasks evenly among allies without leaving fractions.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Lava Tube Tunnel: a glowing lava tube
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Read n. Add all whole numbers from 1 through n, then display the total. For n = 0, display 0. Test dataset 4: {'n': 0}; {'n': 9}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Divide Or Floor' (Week 2 slot 4), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Lava Tube Tunnel'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Collect 240 points of cooling flasks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
source_lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 240, or lives reach 0.
source_game_title: Divide Or Floor – Lava Tube Tunnel Rush
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
